assemble.prompt: Match each term to its definition.

items.label: Weight
items.clue: Mass multiplied by gravitational field strength.

items.label: Kinetic energy
items.clue: Half the mass multiplied by the square of the speed.

items.label: Work done
items.clue: Force multiplied by distance moved along its line of action.

items.label: Pressure
items.clue: Force normal to a surface divided by the area of that surface.

questions.stem: An electric heater transfers 6000 J of energy in 30 s. Which statement about its power is correct?

options.text: Its power is 180 000 W, from energy times time
Its power is 200 W, from the energy over time
Its power is 0.005 W, from the time over the energy
Its power is 6000 W, the energy transferred

questions.stem: A motor does 900 J of work in 45 s. What is its power output, and why?

options.text: 40 500 W, because power is work done times time
0.05 W, because power is time divided by work done
20 W, because power is work done divided by time
900 W, since work done and power are the same

questions.stem: A motor is supplied with 500 J and usefully transfers 300 J, wasting 200 J. What is its efficiency?

options.text: 0.6, from the useful 300 J divided by the 500 J input
1.5, since a good motor can be more than 100% efficient
0.4, from the wasted 200 J divided by the input
1.67, from the 500 J input divided by 300 J

questions.explanation: efficiency = useful output energy transfer / total input energy transfer.

questions.stem: A pump has a total power input of 400 W and a useful power output of 250 W. What is its efficiency?

options.text: 1.6, from the total input divided by the useful output
0.375, from the 150 W wasted power over the input
0.625, from the useful output divided by the total input
150 W, the difference between the two power values

questions.explanation: efficiency = useful power output / total power input = 250/400.

questions.stem: A wave has a frequency of 25 Hz and a wavelength of 400 cm. What is its wave speed?
questions.explanation: The wavelength is 4.00 m, so v = f λ = 25 x 4.00 = 100 m/s.

questions.stem: A current of 3.0 A flows for 2.0 minutes. What charge flows?
questions.explanation: Q = I t with the time converted to 120 s gives 3.0 x 120 = 360 C.

questions.stem: A 6.0 V supply drives a current of 0.50 A through a resistor. What is its resistance?
questions.explanation: Rearranging V = I R gives R = V/I = 6.0/0.50 = 12 Ω.

questions.stem: A torch bulb works at 4.5 V and draws a current of 0.20 A. What is its power?
A current of 3.0 A passes through a resistor of resistance 4.0 Ω. Which working gives the power dissipated?
questions.explanation: P = I² R squares the current before multiplying by the resistance.

questions.stem: A 2000 W heater is switched on for 5.0 minutes. How much energy is transferred?
questions.explanation: E = P t with the time as 300 s gives 2000 x 300 = 600 000 J.

questions.stem: A charge of 8.0 C moves through a potential difference of 12 V. How much energy is transferred?
A block of mass 240 kg has a volume of 0.30 m³. What is its density?
